title: Restaurant storefront: fallbacks for optional sections that outlive the outage
name: Storefront page fallbacks

questions.prompt: The reviews service had a 30-second blip at lunchtime. Restaurant pages handled it well (menus still loaded, reviews showed 'unavailable'), but customers kept seeing 'reviews unavailable' and no delivery ETA on some restaurants for about a minute after reviews and ETA were healthy again. Support also noticed that those responses say Cache-Control: no-store. Fix restaurantPage.ts so the tests pass.
